title: jope.hwm/v1
description: One high-water mark: the best program known for an exact cut under an evaluator identity. identity_sha256 = sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact) of {task, dataset_hash, cut_id, evaluator_sha256, vocabulary_sha256, protocol}. Strict improvement only under the metric's direction (r2/oof_r2/auc/macro_f1/negative_mase higher; rmse/logloss/mase lower); ties keep the older record; an unbound evaluator never displaces a bound one. Written to hwm/<task>/<dataset_hash>/<cut_id>/current.json and, as an event, to hwm/ledger/<yyyy>/<mm>/<ulid>.jsonl.

runtime_seconds.description: Fit/evaluate wall seconds of the winning program.

search_seconds.description: Search wall seconds spent to find it, when recorded.

sha256.description: sha256 of the evaluator binary, or `unbound`.

version.description: Free-form version label of the evaluator (binary name, schema or legacy tag).

dsl.description: The program in its source DSL.

semantic_sha256.description: Semantic (normalised) hash when the source recorded one.

HwmIdentity.description: What `identity_sha256` hashes: the canonical JSON of exactly these six fields.

cut_id.description: Split/fold identity: sha256 of the canonical JSON that names the cut (see docs/learning.md).

dataset_hash.description: Dataset content hash (16 hex for catalogued datasets; legacy sources keep their own ids).

evaluator_sha256.description: sha256 of the evaluator binary, or `unbound`.

protocol.description: Scoring protocol the score was measured under.

vocabulary_sha256.description: sha256 of the grammar vocabulary, or `unbound`.

bundle_id.description: Bundle id the record was migrated from, or `unbound`.

git_sha.description: git sha of the tree that produced the record, or `unbound` for legacy imports.

record_sha256.description: sha256 of the record blob under `blobs/sha256/` (the original bytes for migrated records).

run_id.description: Source-specific run identity (observation path, generation id, track/version, ...).

direction.description: Redundant with the metric table; recorded so a ledger reader needs no code to rank.

benchmark_valid.description: True only for scores measured under a benchmark protocol (never for HWM search scores).

identity_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of `identity`.

improvement_number.description: 0 for the first record of a chain, +1 per strict improvement.

legacy_identity_sha256.description: The source's own identity key (`parallel.cut_champion.v1`: `Identity::key()`), when one exists.

prev_event_sha256.description: sha256 of the event/record this one improved on in its chain, null for the first.

replayable.description: True when the bound evaluator can reproduce the score (`hwm replay`); unbound = false.

sealed.description: True for sealed (`meta_test`) records: kept, never exported to corpora.

ts_unix.description: Unix seconds the score was achieved.
